callTitle: Call for proposals to prevent and combat gender-based violence and violence against children
descriptionByte:
Scope:

This topic is one of the 5 policy priorities of the call for proposals for EU action grants to prevent and combat gender-based violence and violence against children under the Citizens, Equality, Rights and Value Programme (CERV).

For further information about the call and its conditions, please see the call document.
